changes: POST /api/v2/projects/{projectUuid}/ai-access/service-account/test-access — api path removed without deprecation

declaredBreaks.reason: Agent identity (beta, agent-identity feature flag) removes POST /api/v2/projects/{projectUuid}/ai-access/service-account/test-access and the exported AgentAccessReport, AgentAccessTestRequest and BigqueryAgentAccessProbe types. API clients that called the per-table access check get a 404 and must use POST .../ai-access/service-account/test instead, which still checks the AI service account key. Only the Lightdash frontend called the removed endpoint, so no rolling upgrade is affected.
